articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: When capital can't move fast enough, markets pay the price
articles.snippet: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, LMAX Group's Jenna Wright argues that markets break down not from too little capital but from capital stuck in the wrong place, trapped by settlement cycles while risk reprices by the minute. She makes the case that stablecoins and tokenization are quietly becoming the plumbing that lets money move as fast as the risk it supports.

articles.title: Bitcoin holds near $64,000 as U.S. inflation data looms, Harmony exploit rattles altcoins
articles.snippet: Markets are quiet ahead of the July inflation print, with bitcoin little changed, oil near $90 and Harmony nursing a fresh exploit.

articles.title: Harmony’s ONE dives 40% after an attack appears to mint tokens equal to quarter of supply
articles.snippet: Harmony said in Asian morning hours it is working with exchanges to freeze funds and preparing a software fix.

articles.title: CFTC orders Kalshi to continue offering prediction markets in New York after state lawsuit
articles.snippet: New York sued Kalshi last month in a bid to block it from operating sports-related prediction markets.

articles.title: Slovenia joins EU’s MiCA stablecoin register with first issuer
articles.snippet: Slovenia entered the EU’s MiCA stablecoin register through electronic money institution Dinaro, as the update also added two new CASPs.
